verdict: Organic presence is the only active engine — paid channels are fully off.
narrative: Across all three locations this period, paid advertising on Meta and Google ran zero spend and generated zero leads — your Google Business Profile activity is the sole source of measurable engagement. Combined, the three profiles logged 406 total actions in the last 28 days, including 18 calls, 284 direction requests, and 104 website clicks. O'Hare Precision is the strongest organic performer with 202 GBP actions and 396 search clicks, though both are softening week-over-week; Advance Grinding saw a sharp GBP surge mid-period that has since leveled off; and Forte Metals' GBP activity fell sharply in the last 7 days, likely amplified by a single high-traffic day earlier in the period inflating the baseline. Paid campaigns are being reviewed for reactivation, which would give all three locations a demand engine independent of organic fluctuation.

watch_item.issue: Organic visibility is declining at both Forte Metals (GBP down 77% week-over-week) and O'Hare Precision (search clicks down 29% week-over-week), with no paid channel as a backstop.
watch_item.fix: Paid campaign reactivation is under review so that lead flow is no longer entirely dependent on organic search momentum.
